evidence.claim: Transaction amount $117 is below the card’s 90th percentile $160.94
Billing region 181.0 has never been used before on this card
Parallel home activity: three other transactions in different regions within days
Several prior closed cases with out_of_region_use pattern were confirmed fraud
Policy recommends BLOCK_CARD only when the customer denies the transaction

case.summary: The $117 purchase falls within the cardholder’s normal spending range and repeats a pattern of four identical prior transactions. Although it occurred in an unseen billing region and alongside other regional activity, the cardholder confirmed the charge, and policy only calls for blocking on a denial. Consequently, the evidence points to a legitimate transaction despite the out‑of‑region flag.
